description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to network diagnostics such as pinging hosts, tracing routes for IPv4 and IPv6, and checking connectivity status. It includes functions for validating IP addresses, setting and getting configuration values, and returning diagnostic results in JSON format.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets configuration values for network diagnostics.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for network diagnostics.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates if the provided link (host) is valid.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates if the provided IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) is valid.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for trace route hops.
